name: Tite Creeper Drop-8 Coverage Trap
formation: Penny 5-1-5 Sim Rush vs 11P Gun 2x2 Spacing

summary.motive: Simulate a heavy 5-man Penny rush pre-snap, then drop both outside linebackers into underneath passing lanes to eliminate quick-game hot reads in Drop-8 coverage.
summary.keyDefender: LOLB & ROLB executing bluff-and-drop into hook-curl passing lanes
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses rely on quick slants and seams to beat 5-man pressures; dropping 8 turns those hot routes into contested traps with zero open receivers.
summary.failureMode: Three-man rush failing to generate pressure over 4+ seconds, allowing a mobile QB to scramble or break contain.

beats.title: 5-Man Pressure Look at the Line
beats.text: Five rushers crowd the line of scrimmage in a Penny front, prompting the offense to set up quick hot answers against expected 5-man man-blitz pressure.

beats.title: Edge Linebackers Bail into Passing Lanes
beats.text: At the snap, both LOLB and ROLB bluff penetration then abruptly bail into the intermediate hook-curl lanes, creating an 8-man coverage shell.

beats.title: Hot Reads Completely Blanketed
beats.text: The QB looks for his hot slant to X and crosser to Y, only to find LOLB and MIKE sitting directly in both throwing windows with no open targets.

beats.title: Drop-8 Coverage Sack
beats.text: With eight defenders blanketing four receivers and nowhere to throw, the 3-man interior rush collapses the pocket for a drive-ending coverage sack.

relations.tell: Both edge rushers bluff penetration then bail into intermediate hook-curl lanes as defense drops 8.
